prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE grayscale companion model-sheet atlas for Reading Adventure.
Reference image 1 is PET's Silva stage atlas: STYLE ONLY, retain smooth black contours, flat clean white and gray surfaces and expressive gentle eyes. Reference image 2 is the Reading Adventure dog identity: preserve the dog's floppy ears, friendly face and seated pose but fully redraw its pixel art in smooth PET style.
Create exactly SIX distinct full-body companions in a transparent atlas, THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows. Row 1: a small friendly seated puppy with floppy ears; a small seated domestic cat with curled tail; a round fluffy hamster with small visible feet. Row 2: a white forest fox with dark-tipped large ears and bushy tail; a small gentle baby dragon with small wings, simple curved horns and rounded feet; a more majestic but friendly ancient dragon with larger wings and long curled tail, still readable and coherent.
Every creature has a clear BLACK outer contour, about 1.3% of subject height, stronger than gray interior shading. Four flat gray values plus white and black, no gradient or halftone, clean surfaces. Soft organic silhouette, matching human hero examples in same storybook world. Large clear eyes, no long eyelashes, natural limbs, all paws correctly connected. All creatures face slightly left towards a hero but keep both eyes visible when possible. Same baseline per row, natural species proportions. Exactly one creature per cell with generous transparent gutters and outer margins. Complete ears, wings, paws and tails.
No text, labels, lines between cells, borders, UI, aura, glow, scenery, pedestal, ground or cast shadow. Genuine transparent background, opaque white interiors. No pixel art or stepped outlines, no hatching, no mottled texture, no photorealism or 3D.
name: companions-approved
